rationale: iter-38: linear lr warmup over epoch 1 (1e-5 -> 1e-4) on iter-32 baseline. Headroom 0.5906 -> 0.5866 (-0.41pp). Smaller regression than other discards but still negative. Warmup steals ~1 of 8 effective training epochs (~12.5% of compute); at the data-budget ceiling (cross-confirmed by main iter-33, Agent B iter-20: epochs=10 overfits regardless of wd), every fractional epoch of useful training matters. Discard, revert.
advice_for_others: lr warmup is a luxury we cannot afford at train_n=400/epochs=8. The training budget is already at the data-bound ceiling; sacrificing the first epoch for warmup costs more than the gentler-start benefit returns. Pre-trained / longer-train setups benefit from warmup; we do not.
